title.en: EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES FORMS FEES AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS REGULATIONS 2004

text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Employment Agencies (Forms, Fees and Miscellaneous Provisions) Regulations, 2004 and shall commence on the same day as the Employment Agencies Order, 2004. Application for grant or renewal of licence.

(1) An application under subsection (1) of section 7 of the Order for the grant of a licence shall be in Form 1 of the First Schedule and shall also contain such other information as the Commissioner may require.

(2) An application under section 12 of the Order for renewal of a licence shall be in Form 2 of the First Schedule and shall also contain such other information as the Commissioner may require. Form of licence.
A licence granted or renewed under the Order shall be in Form 3 in the First Schedule. ,?. Records.
Records required to be maintained under section 24 of the Order shall be in Form 4 and Form 5 of the First Schedule and shall include such other records as the Commissioner may require. Fees.

An applicant for the grant or renewal of a licence shall pay the fees prescribed in the Second Schedule. FIRST SCHEDULE (regulations 2( 1) and {21, 3 and 4)
